description:
Today's real deals at Aldi, Tesco, SuperValu, Dunnes Stores and Lidl:
    offers at the lowest price on record for that product at that shop, or
    the first offer it has ever had. Each is measured against the product's
    own price history, not the shop's was price, so a recurring or
    long-running price does not count as a deal.

    The biggest saving comes first, and the shops are mixed so one shop does
    not fill the top of the list. Every promotion on sale is judged, so this
    covers them all, and offset reaches every deal. Covers food, drinks,
    alcohol, household, baby and pet products unless another aisle is named.
    Tobacco, infant formula and medicines are never included.

    Args:
        query: words in the product's name or brand, e.g. "coffee" or "heinz".
        category: an aisle or shelf, e.g. "frozen", "household" or "toiletries".
        store: one of "aldi", "tesco", "supervalu", "dunnes", "lidl". Leave it
            out for all five.
        limit: how many deals to return in one page (default 20, max 200).
        offset: how many deals to skip, for the next page (default 0).

    Returns {"as_of", "note", "total", "deals"}. total counts every deal for
    this search, across all pages. Each deal has name, store, pack,
    you_pay, regular_price, saving_eur, saving_pct, card_needed, buy_quantity,
    offer_ends, url and category, and the record behind it: kind, lowest_since,
    low_before, low_before_date, run_start, days_on_offer and started_today.
    One credit per deal returned.
